acceptanceCriteria: dogfood-change_test.sh seeds a stale .stderr in the directory the flow actually uses and asserts its removal.
A dispatch test drives the ledger past the rotation size and asserts events.jsonl.1 exists and the live file restarts.
body:
Observed 2026-10-07 by a read-only cleanup audit of the orchestrator session (code at batch 4 head 5808c26c; installed corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 build 360, corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202). Owner goal: keep Corvint lean and efficient on disk and CPU.

1. script/dogfood-change_test.sh:417 writes a stale .stderr into $test_root/repo but runs the flow in the clone default-repo, so the stale file is never in the run's evidence directory and nothing asserts it is removed.
2. The dispatcher ledger rotation to events.jsonl.1 at 16 MiB (internal/tasks/dispatch/ledger.go:995) is not exercised by any test in internal/tasks/dispatch or internal/tasks/cli.

Expected: both cleanup paths have maintained tests.

completion.reason: Delivered in PR beamfall/corvint#649 (rc3 cleanup), merged to main 2026-10-07T13:49:36Z as ce6313a015bf94d1dc675eb2130b2c2c3851c65a. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-07-v1-0932-cleanup-test-gaps.md, docs/decisions/0440-rc3-cleanup-requirements-accepted-2026-10-07.md and the sealed CEM .corvint/changes/48c959dbb62e0cc79ed4c81cc90a524920827e0f.cem.json at that commit (each digest is that file's sha256). The build-log entry records the change, the maintained tests and the Codex review with its repairs; this ticket adds maintained tests only and needs no requirement. The batch passed focused package tests, go vet on darwin/linux/windows, the doc gates, dogfood check and seal, and every hosted CI check on the merge head. NOT_RUN: make gate, the live macOS update lifecycle, Linux dispatcher runtime and live dispatcher qualification. Native complete is refused with STALE_TREE (V1-0557), hence manual completion.

title: Test gaps: dogfood stale *.stderr clearing and dispatcher events.jsonl rotation are untested
